reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: deposit_limit_breached is called in market.move:278 (non-test). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; attack vector is any user via public deposit entry point (untrusted). Gate 3: reserve.move is in scope. Code confirms double-subtraction: exchange_rate uses cash_plus_borrows_minus_reserves=(cash+debt-cash_reserve), so total_deposit_plus_interest=cash+debt-cash_reserve; the formula then subtracts cash_reserve again, yielding cash+debt+increment-2*cash_reserve>limit instead of cash+debt+increment-cash_reserve>limit. An attacker can trigger this via the public deposit entry point (market.move:278) by depositing after protocol fees have accrued (growing cash_reserve), causing deposit_limit_breached to return false when total deposits reach up to max_deposit_amount+2*cash_reserve, bypassing the deposit cap by up to twice the accumulated protocol reserve.
